content: Welcome back! What’s your tax situation today?
If I buy equipment on December 28, can I still take first-year write-offs?
Yes—**place it in service** before year-end and claim **Section 179** and/or **bonus depreciation** under **§168(k)** for the business-use portion. Date of **use**, not purchase, controls.

1) Document the in-service date (delivery, install, first business use).
2) Compute business-use %.
3) File **Form 4562**—Part I for §179, Part II for bonus.
4) Keep vendor invoices, install tickets, and usage logs as substantiation.

Yes—apply **§179 first** (subject to income and investment limits), then bonus on the remaining basis. If income is light, rely more on bonus. Heavy vehicles and short-life assets often yield the largest year-one result.
